name: Kyou * Shi ~Nerawareta Seifuku~
source:
The story behind the game is about you being hired as a teacher at an all girls school. And because of the pervert you are, you somehow take advantage of the girl students around you. There are three different linear story-lines depending on chosen specialization: P.E teacher, Arts teacher, or a Chem teacher.

[From [url=http://www.densetsu.com/display.php?id=317&style=alphabetical]animedensetsu[/url]]
translation:
玩家受聘到女子学校任教。身为一个变态，你会设法利用周围的女学生。游戏按照所选专业分为体育、美术与化学教师三条彼此独立的线性剧情。

[译自 [url=http://www.densetsu.com/display.php?id=317&style=alphabetical]Anime Densetsu[/url]]
